text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, our full-fledged training
with Nice Nature in preparation for her Debut
finally begins.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, I wanted to see her current abilities.
So, I asked other Umamusume for help
and set up a mock race, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...H-Hold on.
Whoa, whoa, whoa, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
There's no "what's the matter" or anything like that.
It is what it is.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, setting up a mock race for me was reaaally appreciated. Much appreciated, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah!!
Today I'm gonna run with everything I've gotーー!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I sure love that high-spirited attitude of yours!
I don't plan on losing, either!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, what is up with this lineup!?
It's packed with nothing but absolute powerhouses...!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is true. The ones I called out to are all notable talents within the academy.
Among them, it seems those who are particularly caring and curious have gathered here.
choice_data_list: It's the perfect test of ability!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
T-That might be true, but still~...!
I'm just gonna end up humiliating myself with a loss~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—...And so, while Nice Nature was feeling timid beforehand,
once things got going...!”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa...!
Nnnnghh...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Nature, nice going!
Look at you keeping up with that amazing crowd!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
She consistently puts up solid results,
she really is strong, isn't she...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as the observing girls said,
Nice Nature's run was truly magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah... *sigh*~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Third place again, huh...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, yeah. I get it.
Taking 3rd place against that lineup is amazing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, I had the best bracket and everything...
They even tailored the distance for me, and this is the result? Man...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She doesn't seem very satisfied herself.
And so—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Nature!
It's a marvelous day for a race☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya wants to see Nature-chan go all out!
As a mature woman, I'll be your opponent♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I switched up the roster and set up another mock race.
All the girls seemed to be acquaintances of Nice Nature—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer-san~,
you just dragged your favorite over here, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, you've got great taste~.
I get it. If I had to pick, I'd go with these ones too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Just kidding, just kidding, I get it. Despite their cute faces, those girls are seriously fast.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nature-chaaan!
Hurry, hurry, let's run together~☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, is she an angel?
I feel like running alongside her would purify my soul.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Even while joking around like that,
once the race starts...!”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Nature, you're amazing!
You're keeping right up with those two blazing ahead!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Alrighty, came in 3rd place here too, huh...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Those kids are just so young~
Way too much energy for me to handle, honestly.
choice_data_list: It probably won't change that much.
It probably won't change that much.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, it makes a huge difference.
Even just a single year makes a world of difference, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...So, you get it now, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, why do you think I was running just now?
You were watching to see what I'm capable of, weren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—"Something's just not quite there."
That's just who I am.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I can get into a good position, but from there, it just doesn't translate into a win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...She possesses genuine ability.
The fact that she took 3rd place in this mock race
regardless of who she was up against is proof of that."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, she doesn't seem to think so herself.
As I wonder how to explain it to her...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aah!!
Are you doing something fun!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!
Teio...!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Were you doing a mock race?
Man, you've got zero sense!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—To not invite me,
when I'm the one riding high on the biggest roll right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio. Just as she says,
she's the most talked-about Umamusume of this generation.
Her ability was already proven well before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, she is undeniably the obstacle
that Nice Nature must overcome
in order to seize glory.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...The amazing thing about this girl is that you can never
truly call it 'overconfidence.'

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Whatever works, but come on,
get ready, get ready!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ……Hm?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Why the blank look?!
It's a one-on-one duel, a D-U-E-L♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I will take you on
myself, in person!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...S-Seriously... Facebook?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, an impromptu showdown between Nice Nature and Tokai Teio kicked off, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Phew.
The setting sun really stings the eyes, don't it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, totally lost!
Tokai Teio really is way too strong!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The showdown against Tokai Teio was a total defeat.
Nice Nature simply couldn't catch up
to her front-running rival.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, against a girl like that, you couldn't help it! You did great, especially right after running with Mayano and the others.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I see. It's always just ending at "well done."
That's my life for you—nowhere near dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, Trainer... are you still saying
you want to 'aim for victory' with me?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to work hand-in-hand with her
to make her dream of "shining bright" come true.
That feeling will never change.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...I have wondered for some time,
where does that confidence of yours come from?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Your eyes are shining way brighter
than mine at this point, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if I can live up to those expectations, though.
Well, I suppose so...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Surely even I'm allowed
to take a little peek into a dream!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so began the days of
training alongside Nice Nature
toward her grand dream!"
